mapper.sql: dept_type, auto_enable, require_active_member, default_quota_bytes, status, version, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark
config_id, dept_id, enabled, quota_bytes, tree_budget_bytes, member_write_mode, lifecycle_status, config_source, version, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark
mapper.select: select d.dept_id as deptId, d.parent_id as parentId, d.ancestors as ancestors, d.dept_name as deptName, d.dept_type as deptType, d.status as status, d.del_flag as delFlag, (select count(*) from sys_user u where u.dept_id = d.dept_id and u.status = '0' and u.del_flag = '0') as activeMemberCount from sys_dept d where d.dept_id = #{deptId}

select d.dept_id as deptId, d.parent_id as parentId, d.ancestors as ancestors, d.dept_name as deptName, d.dept_type as deptType, d.status as status, d.del_flag as delFlag, (select count(*) from sys_user u where u.dept_id = d.dept_id and u.status = '0' and u.del_flag = '0') as activeMemberCount from sys_dept d order by d.parent_id, d.order_num, d.dept_id

select r.role_id as roleId, r.data_scope as dataScope, rd.dept_id as deptId from sys_user_role ur join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id and r.status = '0' and r.del_flag = '0' left join sys_role_dept rd on rd.role_id = r.role_id and r.data_scope = '2' where ur.user_id = #{userId} and exists ( select 1 from sys_role_menu rm join sys_menu m on m.menu_id = rm.menu_id where rm.role_id = r.role_id and m.status = '0' and m.perms = 'drive:department:manage' ) order by r.role_id, rd.dept_id
select from drive_org_type_rule order by field(dept_type, 'GROUP', 'COMPANY', 'STORE', 'WAREHOUSE'), dept_type
mapper.update: update drive_org_type_rule set auto_enable = #{autoEnable}, require_active_member = #{requireActiveMember}, default_quota_bytes = #{defaultQuotaBytes}, status = #{status}, version = version + 1, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = #{updateTime}, remark = #{remark} where dept_type = #{deptType} and version = #{version}
mapper.select: select from drive_org_space_config where dept_id = #{deptId} for update
select from drive_org_space_config order by dept_id
mapper.update: update drive_org_space_config set enabled = #{enabled}, quota_bytes = #{quotaBytes}, tree_budget_bytes = #{treeBudgetBytes}, member_write_mode = #{memberWriteMode}, lifecycle_status = #{lifecycleStatus}, config_source = #{configSource}, version = version + 1, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = #{updateTime}, remark = #{remark} where dept_id = #{deptId} and version = #{version}
